principle: One chart per explicit dashboard request, generated from validated SQL results; no fixed inventory outline.
global_rules: All chart values originate from the existing read-only SQL agent.
Keep original rows, SQL, sources, historical scope, and limitations.
Never combine stock balances across snapshots or infer an unverified currency.
Donut slices require complete exclusive groups; overlapping flags and truncated results are ineligible.
Clarification, permission denial, empty results, and query failures produce no chart.

cases.question: Show a line chart of monthly revenue during 2022.
Show a bar chart of stockout count by category at 2022-12-31.
Show a donut chart of session share by traffic source during 2022.
